
### internationalized domain names  {.smaller}


* [https://日本レジストリサービス.jp](https://日本レジストリサービス.jp)
* how does this work? 
<hr class="vspace" />
* becomes: [https://xn--vckfdb7e3c7hma3m9657c16c.jp/](https://xn--vckfdb7e3c7hma3m9657c16c.jp/)  

   * encoding scheme called <i>punycode</i>



### IDN homograph attacks 


* <code>bаnkofamerica.com</code>
* <code>xn--bnkofamerica-x9j.com</code>
* <code>а</code> = U+0430 = CYRLLIC SMALL LETTER A


### defenses against homograph attacks  {.smaller}


* at registries, restrict domain registration 

   * disallow mixed scripts (e.g. latin and cyllric)
   * test if looks identical to registered domains

* at browsers, restrict display in non-<code>xn-…</code> form 

   * allow-list for ‘good’ top-level domains (e.g. <code>.gr</code>, <code>.jp</code>, etc.)
   * otherwise, only allow known non-confusing combinations
